Subject: RE: Brenvale Lounge Group - Unable to Quote

Hi Marcus,

Thank you for thinking of us for Brenvale Lounge Group.

Unfortunately, we'll need to pass on this opportunity. This risk falls outside our appetite for a few reasons:

• We don't write nightclubs or bars with entertainment
• Louisiana accounts require special approval we can't obtain for this class
• The five-year loss history exceeds our $250K threshold

Given the entertainment venue exposure, I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty market that focuses on hospitality and nightlife risks.

I appreciate you considering us, and please keep us in mind for other submissions that might be a better fit.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
